category_specific_evidence: Commit and PR body: fixes an MLIR error when doing layout conversions involving f8 types, which are not representable in LLVM IR; unrealized conversion casts must cancel out.
passes.cc comment: upstream MLIR ExtractStridedSlice pattern does not handle floats narrower than 16-bit that aren't representable in LLVM IR.

New test test_fp8_relayout uses shape (128, 32) and dtype jnp.float8_e4m3fn, parameterized over from_narrow in {False, True} (layout widths 4 and 8), with input jax.random.normal(jax.random.key(10)) cast to dtype.
Test checks np.testing.assert_array_equal(kernel(x), x), i.e. exact equality, not a numeric tolerance.

Code change: for element types with float bit width <= 8, the source is bitcast via UnrealizedConversionCastOp to an integer vector of the same width, and the result is cast back to the original float type.
Pass pipeline reorder in custom_call.cc moves reconcile-unrealized-casts after mosaic-convert-gpu-to-llvm; ConvertGpuToLLVMPass marks UnrealizedConversionCastOp legal.
reproduction_risks: Pass ordering of reconcile-unrealized-casts relative to mosaic-convert-gpu-to-llvm matters for the fix; reordering the pipeline may reintroduce the MLIR error.
Test skips under wg semantics (skip_if_wg_semantics, failed to infer layouts), so reproduction must not use that semantics mode.
